login.title: Sign in this computer
login.help: Once signed in, it shows up in your list of computers
panel.close_aria: Close window. Deskway Host keeps running in the background
panel.autostart_off_note: (off: open Deskway Host on this computer when you need it)
panel.autostart_confirm: When this is off, Deskway Host won't run after this computer restarts: it shows as offline in your list and can't be reached remotely. The next time you open Deskway Host on this computer, it starts and Start with Windows turns back on.
panel.prevent_sleep_note: On battery power, this setting pauses below {percent}%.
panel.qr_title: Scan this QR code with your phone's camera
panel.qr_help: After scanning, tap “Add” on the phone and it can control this computer. For a computer without a camera: in its browser, click this computer and choose “Request control”.
panel.remove_all_confirm: Remove all? Every phone or computer will then have to be added again here, at this computer, before it can control it.
panel.sign_out_text: This computer leaves your account; it can be controlled again only once it is signed in again.
panel.ai_on: AI control is allowed on this computer.
panel.ai_stopped: AI control is stopped. To allow it again, turn on “Allow AI control” in My devices.
status.waiting: Waiting for approval on a signed-in device. Approve only the request showing code {code}
status.service_connecting: Connecting to the Deskway Host service
status.service_starting: Starting Deskway Host. Confirm in the window that opens
status.service_down: The Deskway Host service isn't running
ask.title: “{name}” wants to control this computer
ask.body: From {from}. Only allow it if the code shown on that device matches the one below.
mac.permissions_aria: macOS permissions needed for remote control
mac.permission_hint: Turn on the permissions when macOS asks, then connect remotely.
mac.screen_requested: After enabling Screen Recording, quit and reopen when macOS asks, or restart here.
mac.full_disk_access_hint: Skips folder-by-folder prompts when you transfer files or an AI client works with files.
mac.login_settings: Approve the login item in System Settings
mac.login_cleanup_retry: Try again to stop opening at login
mac.cleanup: Deskway Host is still registered to open at login.
mac.login_unavailable: Open Deskway.app to set up the login item
mac.plist_screen: Deskway Host shares this Mac’s screen so that your approved devices can see and control it.
mac.plist_downloads: Deskway Host saves files sent from your other devices to the Deskway folder in Downloads.
note.image: Received 1 image, copied to the clipboard
problem.tls: Can't make a secure connection to the server
problem.network: Can't reach the server. Check the network
problem.revoked: The server no longer recognizes this computer. Sign in again
err.webview: Couldn't create the window. This computer may be missing WebView2
err.panel: Couldn't create the Deskway Host panel
err.not_signed_in: This computer isn't signed in yet
err.pipe_taken: Another program is using the Deskway Host service pipe
err.too_many: Too many attempts. Try again later
err.computer_limit: This account has as many computers as it may have. Remove one in “My devices” on the website first
err.keep_awake: Can't keep this computer from sleeping
err.mac_login_on: Can't set Deskway Host to open at login
err.mac_login_off: Can't stop Deskway Host opening at login
err.mac_login_app: Open Deskway Host from Deskway.app to set it to open at login
install.shortcut_desc: Control this computer from your phone or another computer
cli.enrolled: Added: {name}. Approve it in a signed-in browser.
cli.pair_code:
Pairing code: {code}

Valid for 10 minutes, and only once. Open this computer in your browser and enter it when asked.
cli.unpaired_all.one: Unpaired {n} passkey. It has to be paired again to connect to this computer.
cli.unpaired_all.other: Unpaired {n} passkeys. They have to be paired again to connect to this computer.
cli.need_passkey_id: A passkey ID, or --all, is required
cli.installed: Installed. Deskway Host now runs as a system service and can also be controlled at the lock screen and sign-in screen.
cli.uninstalled: Deskway Host is uninstalled. Sign-in details stay in C:\ProgramData\Deskway and are used again if you reinstall.
setup.declined: You clicked “No” in the Windows prompt. Nothing was changed.
setup.step_install: Install and start the system service
setup.step_remove: Stop and remove the system service
setup.welcome_body: Control this computer from your phone, tablet or another computer, even at the lock screen and sign-in screen.
setup.install_note: Installing needs administrator rights. Windows asks once: click “Yes”.
setup.installed_body: Use this installer to update to a new version, or to uninstall.
setup.uninstall_body: This computer can no longer be controlled remotely. After uninstalling, it shows as offline in your list of computers.
setup.purge: Also delete this computer's sign-in details and added devices (reinstalling later means signing in and adding them again)
setup.uninstall_note: Needs administrator rights. Windows asks once.
setup.purged: Sign-in details and added devices were deleted.
setup.kept: Sign-in details stay on this computer and are used again if you reinstall.
setup.done_body: Deskway Host starts with Windows and can also be controlled at the lock screen and sign-in screen.
setup.next_body: sign in to your account in the Deskway Host panel that opens.
panel.no_devices_title: No device can control this computer yet
panel.no_devices_text: Add a phone or computer to control this computer from it.
panel.remove_one_text: Once removed, it has to be added again here, at this computer, before it can control it.
panel.remove_one_live: It controls this computer now and is disconnected at once. Once removed, it has to be added again here before it can control it.
panel.qr_wait: Waiting for a scan · closes by itself once added
panel.full_text: Up to {max} devices can control this computer. Remove ones you no longer use, then add the new one. Those unused the longest are at the end of the list.
